title: Skoleoverblikket – Feature usage
description: API requests grouped by product module (skema, ugeplan, vikar, fravær, forældre …), from HttpLogging in Loki.

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: Requests to /api/v1, excluding 404s and health probes.

targets.expr: count(sum by (feature) (count_over_time({service_name="Skoleoverblikket.Api"} | event_name="ResponseLog" | RequestPath!~"/alive|/health" | RequestPath=~"/api/v1/.*" | StatusCode!="404" | panels.title: Slowest request per module
panels.description: The single slowest request per module and time bucket. At this traffic a p95 is just the slowest request anyway, and most of those are cold starts after a deploy (purple markers). The Service health dashboard splits cold from warm and links each slow request to its trace.
